About the Company

Craftsmanship rooted
in the Cape.

Cape Codder Building & Remodeling started in 2022 with a simple mission: durable, well-built exterior work — decks, siding, and custom outdoor showers built to take whatever the coast throws at them.

As word spread, so did the scope of work. Today, as certified general contractors, we handle complete interior transformations too, with kitchens and bathrooms as our specialty — staying on budget, finishing on time, and keeping you informed at every step.

Why Choose Us

Built on the Details

01

Itemized Scoping

Every job is broken down line by line before work starts — materials, labor, and cost, no vague estimates.

02

Regional Material Expertise

We choose cedar, mahogany, and marine-grade materials selected specifically for Cape Cod's salt air and wind exposure.

03

Direct Communication

You work directly with the crew running your project — no layers, no runaround.

04

Attention to Detail

From trim reveals to flashing details, the small things are what hold up over twenty Cape Cod winters.

05

Property Value

Renovations planned to protect and grow the long-term value of your home, not just patch what's visible.

06

One Crew, Start to Finish

Exterior, structural, and finish work handled by one accountable team from first estimate to final walkthrough.
